article.headline: No. 25 Nebraska women cruise past North Carolina A&T 76-35
article.description: — Britt Prince made four 3-pointers and finished with 24 points to lead No. 25 Nebraska to a 76-35 victory over North Carolina A&T on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: No. 25 Nebraska women cruise past North Carolina A&T 76-35

categories.description: North Carolina A&T Aggies @ Nebraska Cornhuskers

event.description: North Carolina A&T Aggies @ Nebraska Cornhuskers

keywords: North Carolina A&T Aggies @ Nebraska Cornhuskers
article.story: LINCOLN, Neb. -- — Britt Prince made four 3-pointers and finished with 24 points to lead No. 25 Nebraska to a 76-35 victory over North Carolina A&T on Tuesday night. Amiah Hargrove scored 13 points and grabbed 10 rebounds for Nebraska (3-0). Ashlyn Koupal added 11 points. Seven players had at least one of the Cornhuskers' 11 steals. Prince made three consecutive 3-pointers in the first quarter as the Cornhuskers jumped out to a 20-6 advantage. She finished with four 3s in the first half to help Nebraska (3-0) take a 34-15 lead into the break. Prince finished 9-of-15 shooting, with three rebounds, three steals, two assists and a block. North Carolina A&T (1-2) didn't score in double digits until the fourth quarter, shooting 14 of 45 from the floor while missing 10 of its 11 3-point attempts. Darrionna Howard led the Aggies with 10 points. Up next North Carolina A&T: at home against Guilford on Friday. Nebraska: faces undefeated Kansas in the MarketBeat Invitational on Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
